hero.title: Frontend Engineer

intro.name: Yuxin Zhang
intro.text: a Software Engineer working across AI/ML and full-stack, based in Beijing with 2 years of industry experience, specialising in data visualisation and AI/ML systems.
intro.textZh: 一位专注于 AI/ML 与全栈开发的软件工程师，现居北京，拥有两年工业经验，专注于数据可视化与 AI/ML 系统。

hero.body: I'm passionate about building platforms that bring AI/ML to real-world applications. My work spans full-stack engineering, ML system integration, and developer tooling — with a focus on making intelligent systems accessible, reliable, and production-ready.
hero.bodyZh: 我热衷于构建将 AI/ML 落地于实际应用的平台。我的工作涵盖全栈工程、ML 系统集成与开发者工具，专注于让智能系统更易用、更可靠、更具生产可用性。
